difficulty_transition_rule: stop at each Difficulty boundary; carry positive excess Movement Result; adjust by new Difficulty minus previous Difficulty
condition_draw_rule: no active-condition maximum; reveal/place immediately and continue replacement draw
deck_exhaustion_rule: shuffle eligible discard into draw pile with seeded RNG; exclude every card still in play
finish_resolution: positive legal movement beyond 26.0/13.0 completes the 0.2/0.1 Finish extension; same-round tiebreak at Round End
milestone_resolution: Water and Aid apply named Condition remedies; Gut Checks use Hand Effort
will_resolution: single-use fallback for otherwise-legal unaffordable Pace
pack_resolution_assumption: deterministic AI consents to the nearest legal same-Pace group at Round Start; Pack preserves 1 Pace Energy
effect_resolution: Event Effects execute only in EFFECT mode; Movement mode uses printed Effort and pays the card Energy cost
